collision_check: Searched openkit-*/fbx for map|compass|divider|ruling|pigment|cartograph|chart|sheet|tray|weight. Near-misses: cartographer pack (chart-weight, compass-divider, map-case-tube, rolled-chart), parchment-sheet-blank (parchment-maker), parchment-sheet-stack (scribe). No map-sheet, ruling-pen or pigment-cake asset.
judgment_calls: Map sheet is larger paper (42x30 vs parchment) with only faint chalk grid strips sitting on top; no coasts/labels/rose = blank, not treasure map
Divider is laid flat, legs open ~18 deg, brass hinge disc; legs untapered square bar (low tris)
Ruling pen nib blades overlap handle end (no gap), no screw = blank
Pigment cakes are 6-seg discs seated on tray floor
Eye-check v1 contact sheet: no floating parts; no fixes needed

textures_note: All nine BaseColor PNGs ship pack-local in tex/. None is byte-identical to any sibling Open Kit pack. T_Brass_BaseColor.png, T_Chalk_BaseColor.png, T_Iron_BaseColor.png and T_Ochre_BaseColor.png are name-clash only with other Open Kit packs (different bytes); T_Azurite, T_Paper, T_Verdigris, T_Vermilion and T_Wood are unique. FBX carry material slots only; Unity maps textures by material slot.
